newsitem.title: FRANCE: Full freighters increase share of Parius cargo-ADP.
newsitem.headline: Full freighters increase share of Parius cargo-ADP.

text.p: The percentage of global air cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports in the first nine months of 1996 arriving and departing on full-freighter flights was up 0.3 percentage points on the same period last year, Aeroports de Paris (ADP) figures show.

Full-freighters had a 39.3 percent share of Jan-Sept 1996 global air cargo throughput (imports and exports) handled at Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports which totalled 815,915 tonnes compared to 39.0 percent in the first nine months of 1995.

In Jan-Sept 60.6 percent of the ADP's global air cargo traffic was carried on passenger and combi flights compared to 61 percent in January-September 1995. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
